tables.name: customer-single-view
tables.description: Shared customer-360 HBase table. This config only models the deposit_account fields written by the Deposit Single View program (this pipeline) -- other pipelines/programs are expected to write other qualifiers under the same info family. Draft uses the 'customer360 version' schema from the source doc, which is broader than the doc's earlier 'version 1.0.1' schema -- see draft notes; confirm which is actually live before creating.

children.name: customer_id
children.description: Row key is the customer's CIF.

children.name: info
children.description: Column family.

children.name: qualifier
children.description: Real qualifiers are compound (deposit_account|<field_name>); the field names below are the known business attributes written by the Deposit Single View program.

children.name: total_traditional_salak_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_type in (3401, 3402) and account_status_code != 4

children.name: count_traditional_salak_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_type in (3401, 3402) and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: total_digital_salak_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_type = 3403 and account_status_code != 4

children.name: count_digital_salak_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_type = 3403 and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: count_total_deposit_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_group in (DDA, SAV, CD) and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: total_deposit_account_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_group in (DDA, SAV, CD) and account_status_code != 4

children.name: count_savings_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_group = SAV and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: total_savings_account_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_group = SAV and account_status_code != 4

children.name: count_fixed_deposit_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_group = CD and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: total_fixed_deposit_account_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_group = CD and account_status_code != 4

children.name: count_current_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_group = DDA and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: total_current_account_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_group = DDA and account_status_code != 4

children.name: total_closed_account
children.description: count where account_status_code = 4

children.name: count_jount_for_children
children.description: count(account_number) where relationship_code = E and account_status_code != 4. Field name has a typo in the source doc ("jount"); kept verbatim to match the real qualifier -- see draft notes. Also note: relationship_code = E doesn't appear in this pipeline's own relationship_code definitions (A/B/C) -- see draft notes.

children.name: has_joint_for_children
children.description: 1 if count_jount_for_children > 0, else 0

children.name: count_special_savings_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_type = 2002 and account_status_code != 4. Source doc types this as decimal, not int -- see draft notes.

children.name: total_special_savings_account_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_type = 2002 and account_status_code != 4

children.name: count_monthly_fixed_deposit_account
children.description: count(account_number) where account_type = 3301 and account_status_code != 4

children.name: total_monthly_fixed_deposit_account_balance
children.description: sum(ending_balance) where account_type = 3301 and account_status_code != 4

children.name: data_date
children.description: Data date of the source year_month partition read
